drive_storage_bytes.label: Drive Storage (bytes)
drive_storage_bytes.description: Storage per member, counting every file they own. 0 means no limit.

drive_max_file_bytes.label: Drive Max File Size (bytes)
drive_max_file_bytes.description: Largest single file a member may upload to Drive. 0 means no limit.

drive_share_links.label: Drive Share Links
drive_share_links.description: Allow members to mint public share links for Drive files and folders.

drive_versioning_depth.label: Drive Versions Kept
drive_versioning_depth.description: How many prior versions of each Drive file to retain. 0 keeps only the current version.

drive_large_file_versioning_depth.label: Drive Versions Kept (Large Files)
drive_large_file_versioning_depth.description: How many prior versions to retain of a Drive file larger than the site's large-file size (drive_large_file_bytes). The smaller of this and Drive Versions Kept applies.
